chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who dies while owing a debt, and a guarantor assumes it on behalf of the creditors, he عليه السلام said: “If the creditors agree, then the liability of the deceased is cleared.”

key_terms.الْغُرَمَاءِ: The creditors to whom the debt is owed.
key_terms.دَيْنٌ: A financial debt owed by the deceased.
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: A guarantor who takes responsibility for repayment.

ai.seo_question: When is a deceased person cleared of debt if someone else guarantees it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the debt of a deceased person when another person guarantees payment to the creditors. It states that if the creditors consent to the guarantee, the deceased is released from liability, showing the importance of creditor approval in financial obligations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5530 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who dies while owing a debt, and a guarantor assumes responsibility for it on behalf of the creditors.
Imam (as) said: "If the creditors agree, then the deceased is cleared of responsibility."
